rows.note: For a remarkable or excellent quality, this is the all-purpose everyday choice.

example.english: The composition of this painting is truly eminent.
example.traditional: 呢幅畫嘅構圖真係出色。
example.jyutping: ne1 fuk1 waa2 ge3 gau3 tou4 zan1 hai6 ceot1 sik1

rows.note: Use this for a distinguished or outstanding person, especially someone who excels in a field.

example.traditional: 佢係一位傑出嘅物理學家。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai6 git6 ceot1 ge3 mat6 lei5 hok6 gaa1

rows.note: Use this only when the person is eminent because they are widely known or famous.

example.english: This chef is an eminent local figure.
example.traditional: 呢位廚師係本地一位出名人物。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai6 cyu4 si1 hai6 bun2 dei6 jat1 wai6 ceot1 meng2 jan4 mat6
